generationInputs.prompt: A vintage-style poster with a limited red-toned palette on a cream background depicts a luminous pink donut, an eggplant, and a banana with syringes amidst a night with lightning and abundant fog. The central focus is a stylized, engraved illustration of a luminous pink donut, appearing weightless with a holographic icing effect. Pink liquid and white spilled milk drip from its base, adorned with numerous diamonds and pink sprinkles. Emerging from the donut's center are two female legs in black fishnet stockings and black high-heeled shoes. Two hands extend, one holding a syringe with glowing liquid and the other a glass pipe. To the side, an eggplant is depicted holding a syringe, and a banana holds a bright syringe. The background is a night scene with striking lightning and heavy fog. At the top, a large, bold headline reads "YO PAS CL SLM FF" arching in all caps. Beneath that, a tagline states "TU VRGN SLM ACT" in stylized font. Mid-century sparkle icons are scattered around the headline, and all fonts have a retro print ad aesthetic.
